exclude.why: wrong key: 'Specially provided by Article 19(1)' but standard fact is press freedom is not specially provided; it is secured under Article 19(1)(a)
wrong key: 'temporary suspension of the right to freedom' but standard fact is a constitutional emergency (Art. 356) leads to President's rule
wrong key: 'based on reasonableness of State action' but standard fact is certiorari brings up the records of a lower court for examination by the superior court
